heading: Monday, November 10, 2025
topLine: Meta releases Omnilingual ASR covering 1,600+ languages.

items.headline: Meta releases Omnilingual ASR covering 1,600+ languages
items.summary: Omnilingual ASR is a family of open speech-recognition models from 300M to 7B parameters covering more than 1,600 languages, including about 500 never before transcribed by AI. Models are released under Apache 2.0, with a transcribed-speech corpus for 350 underserved languages under CC-BY.
